maddeler.e:
تعتصموا (form VIII)
# تَعْتَصِمُوا (taʕtaṣimū) /taʕ.ta.sˤi.muː/: second-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِعْتَصَمَ (iʕtaṣama)
# تُعْتَصَمُوا (tuʕtaṣamū) /tuʕ.ta.sˤa.muː/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِعْتَصَمَ (iʕtaṣama)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
